name: – Niclas Herbst – After § 179 – Am 88
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: 179 a. Calls on the Commission to avoid any communication expenditure during election periods; recalls that the European Data Protection Supervisor (EDPS) has reprimanded the European Commission for unlawfully targeting advertising at citizens via X (formerly Twitter), using "sensitive" personal data on their political opinions, in an attempt to influence political opinions in the Netherlands;
